reviewer_output_text:
Overall verdict: CONDITIONAL PASS

v100 is acceptable to continue into display-only page_details / read-only PathGraph preview integration, with review-only labels preserved. It is not clean enough to call final or promotion-ready.

1. Python.org page-detail preview: CONDITIONAL PASS
What improved

#32 hero code panel and #31 hero text panel no longer visibly overlap. They are now separated into left/right hero panels.

Latest News / Upcoming Events rows are much cleaner than the earlier dense raw Stage2 view.

The page-detail view looks like it is using a cleaned/fused representation rather than replaying every tiny raw OCR fragment.

Bottom partial More appears visually lower-emphasis than before, though it is still visible.

Remaining problems

Hero text panel is still too broad
#31 hero text panel covers a very large empty area. It is not wrong enough to block, but it is not a clean content box.

Top header/control boxes are still oversized
Several top nav/header boxes are tall vertical blocks, especially around Python / PSF / Docs / PyPI / Jobs / Community. This is still display-level roughness.

News / Events rows are cleaner but still not fully structured
They are readable, but section header → list group → list row relationships are still not visually explicit enough.

#42 >>More still looks a bit isolated
It is lower-emphasis, but its parent section relationship is not obvious.

Verdict

Acceptable as review-only page-detail evidence, not a finished page-detail structure.

2. AppleMusic page-detail preview: PASS
What looks good

Main music cards remain primary visible content.

First media row is preserved.

Second row, including the red-star / Favorite Songs card, remains a full media-card slot.

Bottom partial cards are low-emphasis / partial-visible, not promoted to full primary cards.

#8 sidebar background / empty review region is visibly low-emphasis and no longer competes with primary content.

Topbar / left rail / main area structure has not been polluted by Python or QQ cleanup rules.

Remaining problems

Sidebar background is still visually large
It is correctly low-emphasis, but still occupies a lot of visual space.

Topbar remains dense
Header/control boxes are still compact and numerous.

Partial bottom cards must stay review-only
They look correctly downweighted, but should not be treated as complete cards.

Verdict

AppleMusic is suitable as a protected display sample for page_details / read-only preview.

3. QQ page-detail preview: CONDITIONAL PASS
What improved / looks acceptable

Right member list remains present down to lower members, including Ad astra / ADaChi / Aeonoo / Airhead.

The right member list is more complete than earlier versions.

Boundary/review helper region is visually distinct from member rows; it is not easily confused with normal members.

Main chat area, left conversation list, and right sidebar remain separated.

No obvious cross-column overflow from message thread into right sidebar.

Remaining problems

Right notice/member boundary is still visually busy
Notice area, boundary review region, and member list are separate, but still visually crowded.

Member rows are complete but still rough
Rows are present, but avatar/name/role structure is still simplified and not clean.

Message thread remains dense
Message card, image message, bubble, and timestamp/context boxes are still review-level, not clean final structure.

Bottom toolbar/composer remains review-only
It is visible, but not clean enough to treat as a final semantic input region.

Verdict

Acceptable to continue as conditional display-only preview, especially for verifying the right member-list continuation.

Integration decision

Allowed to proceed with panel integration for:

display-only page_details
read-only PathGraph preview scaffold
review-only visual evidence

Required conditions:

- Keep review-only / partial / boundary helper regions visually downgraded.
- Do not treat low-emphasis boxes as primary semantic nodes.
- Keep Python hero/list/card areas marked as conditional.
- Keep QQ right sidebar and message thread marked as review-needed.

This is not an accuracy claim, not E2E success, not an executable PathGraph, and not Execute authorization.
